thread:
Alex M: Heads-up — we need a plan for Dedicated GPU capacity next quarter. Forecasting shows ~25% baseline growth plus recurring experimental spikes. I want to open quota requests and a reserved-burst proposal today.
Maya G: Can you drop numbers? how many GPUs / which regions / cost ballpark?
Alex M: Quick summary:
- Current Dedicated pool active: 140 A100 (40GB) equivalents across us-west1 + eu-west1
- 12-week growth projection: ~25% -> baseline ~175
- Observed spike runs (AB tests + customer demos): up to ~220 sustained for short windows
Proposal:
- Reserve 80 extra A100-equivalent slots as burst-capacity: 50 in us-west1, 30 in eu-west1
- Request cloud quota increases: GPU quota +80, External IPs +120, Regional forwarding rules/NAT IPs +24
- Timeline: quota requests this week, capacity reservations for start of Q2
Estimated cost impact: ~$120k/mo additional if fully provisioned; expected amortized cost ~+$40k/mo using burst-on-demand pattern and spot fallback where possible.
Samir: We also need network headroom — NAT gateway SNAT ports and EIP pool. eu-west1 recently flagged limited A100 stock; do we have fallback regions (europe-west3 / europe-north1)?
Li Yu: For Dedicated we should avoid relying on preemptible for latency-sensitive traffic. Suggest mixed strategy: reserved on-demand for baseline + short-term on-demand burst with auto-fallback to compatible lower-memory SKUs (e.g., A40/H100 mix) if exact A100 quota delayed.
Maya G: Can we reduce requested reserved amount if finance won't ok full 80? what if we ask for 50 now and 30 later?
Alex M: Yes. Staged request is fine. Proposed immediate cloud quota ask: +50 GPUs (30 us-west1,20 eu-west1) +80 EIPs +12 NAT IPs. Follow-up ramp if metrics justify.
Samir: Need me to open support case with cloud? I can file — include project IDs and justification: Dedicated pool scale for customer SLAs and canary capacity for rollouts.
Alex M: Please open. Suggested support body (paste into case):
```
Project: redwood-dedicated-prod
Request: Increase regional GPU quota (A100) and external IPs
Regions and amounts:
- us-west1: +30 A100
- eu-west1: +20 A100
- External IP addresses: +80 (shared across regions)
- NAT/forwarding rules headroom: +12
Reason: Q2 capacity headroom for Dedicated GPU pools to support 25% baseline growth and short-duration spikes up to ~220 GPUs, required for customer SLAs and internal canary rollouts. Will use reserved capacity + on-demand bursts; cost approvals pending.
Cost contact: Finance-Steph@redwood.internal
```
quota-bot: Support case created: CASE-2026-4872. Ticket link: https://console.cloud.provider/support/CASE-2026-4872
Finance-Steph: FYI — rough cap approval needed. Can you attach monthly forecast and worst-case burn? include amortization assumptions.
Alex M: Will post a short cost sheet by EOD. Plan includes staged reserve (50 now, 30 later) to cap near-term expense and keep burst flexibility. Also exploring short-term committed discounts with cloud for the biggest region.
Li Yu: One more ops note — please include request to raise per-VPC route limits and ephemeral port quotas. We hit ephemeral port exhaustion during last spike; NAT autoscaling helped but added latency.
Maya G: Sounds good. @Samir can you file the case and tag infra-sre? then we'll ping sales/customer-ops to notify customers that demo capacity is covered.
Samir: On it — filing now, will paste case id and the gcloud/AWS support text in thread.
Alex M: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — will reconvene after case confirmation and cost sheet.
